note: Illustrative prototype values, not clinically validated. Generated by `python -m reasoning.rule_engine` from the Python rule definitions.

rules.name: Hot, humid conditions with elevated heart rate
rules.description: Heat index >= 32.2 C (from ambient temperature + humidity) AND heart rate elevated (>= 100 bpm, or personal baseline mean + 1.5 std). No activity allowance: exertion in dangerous heat counts as heat-strain evidence.

rules.name: Elevated body temperature in a hot environment
rules.description: Body temperature >= 37.8 C AND ambient temperature >= 32 C. Wearable body temperature may be skin temperature.

rules.name: Poor air quality with SpO2 below personal norm
rules.description: AQI >= 101 OR PM2.5 >= 35 ug/m3, AND SpO2 at or below 94% (or personal baseline mean - 2 points). Needs SpO2 and at least one of AQI / PM2.5; missing data is never evidence.

rules.name: Short sleep with physiological or activity strain
rules.description: Sleep < 6 h AND (heart rate elevated OR activity_level >= 0.8). Needs sleep_duration_hours, which is NOT in the backend contract yet, so this rule stays NOT_EVALUABLE until the field is added.

rules.name: Elevated heart rate at rest
rules.description: Heart rate elevated (>= 100 bpm, or personal baseline mean + 1.5 std) while activity_level <= 0.3.
